title: Vegetarian - Challenge
description: This datapack makes eating meat bad and gives you bad effects to make you a vegetarian. I bet you won't survive this one tho.
body:
# Vegetarian - Challenge

A challenge for my friends to stay vegetarian in-game and not eat meat, it will poison you and affect your performance. This is a datapack so it can be used in vanilla servers. at the end of the day it's just a challenge for those who think minecraft is soo much easy paired with Incendium try your best to beat the game in this datapack no village's are much more useful, I dare you.
